'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Steve Baroni DS Endor: Forest Clearing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Forest Clearing|Endor-D-endorforestclearing.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' No Deployment by React :(
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
